name: system-diagram
description: System Wiring Diagram tools: import a component datasheet into the ECDB (photo, MPN, wires / terminals / built-in connectors with every pin's function; no ID — a person assigns it), and import a diagram drawn in draw.io or Miro as a new wiring-diagram project (boxes → ECDB components, lines → wires). Signs in as you (your hub login).

email.title: Hub email
email.description: Your @lionsbot.com login for the Hardware Tools hub (hub.mechanical.lionsbot.app)

password.title: Hub password
password.description: Your hub password (not your Google or Microsoft one). Kept in the Windows credential store.

miro_token.title: Miro access token (optional)
miro_token.description: Only for importing Miro boards: an access token from a Miro developer app installed on your Miro team (Profile settings > Your apps; boards:read is enough). Leave blank otherwise.
